Bella (Bella Apps)

Location: Europe (UTC+2)

Remote: Yes, remote only (async, written communication)

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI and Claude APIs, AI chatbots (WhatsApp, website), JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, PWAs, Cloudflare Pages/Workers, HTML/CSS

Résumé/CV: demos at https://bellaapps.pages.dev - a recent n8n build (walkthrough video): https://bellaapps.pages.dev/n8n-lead-engine.mp4 and its free JSON: https://bellaapps.pages.dev/n8n-lead-engine.json

Email: bellaapps.studio@gmail.com

Freelance, fixed-price work: workflow automations, AI assistants that answer customers or qualify leads, and small business apps/PWAs. I build with heavy AI assistance (Claude), which keeps prices low, and I test the failure paths before handing anything over: duplicates, failed API calls, retries, missing data. You pay after you have tested and approved the result.

- Bella
